summary.text: Andrew Turner is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 59 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Shelby Slawson.
A military veteran who works as a mechanic, he describes himself as a Blue Dog Democrat.

paragraphs.text: Turner was born in Arlington, Texas, and graduated from Granbury High School.
He served in the U.S. Coast Guard from 2008 to 2013 and began serving in the Texas Air National Guard in 2013.
Turner earned a bachelor's degree from Tarleton State University in 2014 and a graduate degree from the same university in 2020.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Turner said he was raised in a military household and served in the Texas Air National Guard during the BP oil spill and multiple natural disasters.
He listed local control, lowering everyday costs for families, and support for teachers, first responders, farmers and veterans among his campaign messages.
